name: 택배 조회
summary: 택배사를 몰라도 운송장 번호만 주면 CJ대한통운·우체국·한진·롯데·로젠을 차례로 찾아 어디쯤 왔는지 알려 드려요.

example.reply: 로젠택배로 오고 있어요. 오늘 아침 동네 영업소에 도착해서 오늘 안에 배달될 예정이에요.

en.name: Parcel tracking
en.summary: With just a tracking number, even without knowing the carrier, Dool2 checks CJ Logistics, Korea Post, Hanjin, Lotte and Logen in turn and tells you where the parcel is.

example.reply: It is coming with Logen. It reached your local branch this morning and should arrive today.

abilities.title: Find the carrier
abilities.say: Which carrier is this tracking number?
